verbs.name: reflect
verbs.description: Record what this session noticed, in the shape the next session can retrieve. Lands in your own space at once; a proposal to carry it into the operator’s memory waits for blessing. Outcomes you report on applied patches are the loop’s own measure.

attempted.description: What this session set out to do, in one sentence.

cites.description: The nodes you read, by space and id, with the span if it matters.

inferred.description: What you concluded from the observations. Kept apart from them.

observed.description: What actually happened. Facts a later session can rely on, one per entry.

outcomes.description: For each applied patch `orient` showed you: was its hypothesis confirmed or contradicted by this session, and why.

shouldChange.description: What a prompt, skill, verb, or policy should do differently, and why. A wish; `propose` is the patch.

invariants.statement: A call is to a verb in the manifest.
A verb or a source is blessed by the sovereign of its space.
A bridge crosses a wall and is closed once, by the target's sovereign.
A weak reference crosses a wall as text.
The fold is a function: the same log yields the same state.
A tenant sees its own space whole and the other space through blessing.
A signature is frozen at blessing.
A patch is applied only to the base it was proposed against, only by the sovereign, and once.
An outcome cites a patch that was applied.
Every retrieval is an event, with its context and every candidate in rank order; a receipt for a retrieval verb has one.
Every event names its actor in the closed grammar, and an agent event carries a because; the schema refuses one without.

protocol.bless: pnpm fabric bless <verb | source | bridge | patch>
